name: Haebaru Makoto
source:
The owner of share house

Characteristics: Sunny, sexy, and like a Latina. Free

A landlord of Shirokanedai. When his father died, he succeeded all the properties. Owns a lot of them, including a coffee shop named VIENTO in Shirokanedai.
